lines.zh: 骨爪抓地响，腐肉味浓重。

lines.en: Bony body twists, cold winds moan.

lines.zh: 骨足陷进骨髓，越走越深。
lines.en: My bone feet sink deeper into the marrow.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩响同类的尖叫。
lines.en: Each step crunches a kin's scream.

lines.zh: 骸骨拖行，留下腐臭的沟。
lines.en: My carcass drags, leaving a reeking furrow.

lines.zh: 我贴墙滑行，骨节咔哒作响。
lines.en: I slide along the wall, joints clicking.

lines.zh: 腐骨堆中觅食，黑暗中等待。
lines.en: Feast on rotten bones, wait in dark.

lines.zh: 腐骨堆旁蜷坐，窥视猎物。
lines.en: Curl by rotten bones, eye prey.

lines.zh: 我蹲在骨堆里听骨髓流动。
lines.en: I crouch in the bone heap, listening to marrow flow.

lines.zh: 腐肉慢慢从我的肋骨间长出。
lines.en: Rotting flesh slowly grows between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我张开骨笼，又缓缓合上。
lines.en: I open my bone cage, then slowly close it.
The smell of marrow sets me at ease.
Bones turn, gaze fixed on you.

lines.zh: 我所有的眼窝都转向你。
lines.en: Every one of my sockets turns to you.

lines.zh: 骨缝里透出注视的冷光。
lines.en: A watching chill seeps through my bone seams.

lines.zh: 我数着你身上有多少根骨头。
lines.en: I count the bones inside your body.

lines.zh: 你走路的声音像骨髓在流。
lines.en: Your footsteps sound like marrow flowing.

lines.zh: 我抬起骨爪，描出你的轮廓。
lines.en: I raise a claw and trace your outline.

lines.zh: 你不该走进这片骨荒原。
lines.en: You should not have walked into this bone waste.

lines.zh: 我的颈骨一节节转向你。
lines.en: My neck bones turn to you one segment at a time.

lines.zh: 隔着腐雾，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Through the rot-mist I see you clearly.

lines.zh: 你身上没有腐化，真新鲜。
lines.en: You carry no rot. How fresh.

lines.zh: 骨笼正在你头顶长出来。
lines.en: A bone cage is growing above you.
Struggle in the bone cage, with no rescue.
Wander in the bone marrow, unable to escape.
Bone cage bars, cannot break free.
Struggle in the sea of bones, soul terrified.
Scream in the bone cage, unheard.
Bone cage holds you, cannot move.
Scream in the bone cage, helpless.

lines.zh: 骨髓网已经在你脚下了。
lines.en: The marrow web is already beneath your feet.
The call of death beckons you!

lines.zh: 骨髓里的骨笼，正好合你的身量。
lines.en: A bone cage in the marrow fits your size.
The power of corruption surrounds you!
You can't escape the bone cage!

lines.zh: 骨笼里还留着同伴的气味。
lines.en: The bone cage still smells of my kin.

lines.zh: 骨髓里传来同类的尖叫。
lines.en: A kin's scream echoes through the marrow.

lines.zh: 我一叫，同类就从骨髓里冒。
lines.en: I shriek, and my kin rise from the marrow.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声，一群腐化者正在接近。
lines.en: Sssss, a horde of hollowed ones approaches.

lines.zh: 感知到你的存在，它们向你聚拢。
骨笼缓缓张开，准备捕获。
lines.en: The bone cage opens, ready to ensnare.

lines.zh: 骨之触手缠绕，你无处可逃。
骨髓中发出尖锐的嘶鸣。
lines.en: Sharp hisses echo in the marrow.

lines.zh: 腐化的触手紧紧包裹住你。
骨髓深处的尖叫，同类在呼唤。
lines.en: Screeches from the marrow, summoning kin.

lines.zh: 它们的骨髓中寄生着恐惧。
骨笼中发出低沉的喘息。

lines.en: The bone cage locks around you.

lines.zh: 你成了新的猎物，它们注视着你。
lines.en: You are new prey, they watch you.

lines.zh: 感应到你的气息，它们锁定了你。
猎物的气味引来了更多腐化者。
lines.en: More hollowed ones are drawn by the prey's scent.

lines.zh: 它们的眼中闪烁着贪婪的光芒。
你的存在被骨髓中的生物感知。
lines.en: You are sensed by the marrow creatures.

lines.zh: 骨之阴影在黑暗中蔓延。
lines.en: Bone shadows spread in the darkness.

lines.zh: 腐化者之间传递着信息。
它们的尖啸声唤醒了沉睡的同类。
尖叫传开，同类正在赶来。
lines.en: My scream carries; my kin are coming.
On the bone waste, you are surrounded.
My bone cage is ready for you.

lines.zh: 腐化闻到了活人的味道。
lines.en: The rot has caught the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 骨髓深处传来回应的嘶鸣。
lines.en: Answering hisses rise from deep marrow.
Your body heat gives you away.
One scream and the bone cage is set.
Align the bone cage with your prey.

lines.zh: 瞄准猎物的心脏，一击毙命。
lines.en: Target the heart, strike to kill.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它们瞄准了你。
骨之锁链缠绕你的四肢。

lines.en: Their bone claws grip you tightly.

lines.zh: 骨之囚笼中发出威胁的低吼。
它们的尖刺刺入你的皮肤。
骨之囚笼吞噬你的灵魂。
lines.en: The bone cage devours your soul.
The bone cage tightens from all sides.

lines.zh: 我盯住你的脚踝，先断退路。
lines.en: I fix on your ankles and cut off your retreat.

lines.zh: 骨髓顺着我的指节涌出。
lines.en: Marrow seeps out along my knuckles.
A scream builds inside my bone hollows.
I seal the passage behind you.
A bone spike aims at your throat.

lines.zh: 腐化从你的鞋底爬上来。
lines.en: Rot climbs up from your boot soles.

lines.zh: 我们同步了呼吸，也同步了杀意。
lines.en: Our breathing syncs, and so does my hunger.

lines.zh: 你退一步，骨墙就长一寸。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, the bone wall grows.

lines.zh: 我等着你抬手的那一刻。
lines.en: I wait for the moment you raise your arm.
Screaming, I call all my kin.
Bone claws dig into your collarbone!
I pin you into the bone heap!
The bone cage shuts on your legs!
Rotting teeth bite through your armor!
A kin's claw falls from behind you!
The marrow churns and I rise out of it.

lines.zh: 骨荒原裂开，我爬出地面。
lines.en: The bone waste splits and I crawl out.

lines.zh: 腐气聚成形，我睁开了眼。
lines.en: Rot gathers into shape, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从骨笼的缝隙里挤出。
lines.en: I squeeze out from between bone bars.
Bones begin to stitch themselves together.

lines.zh: 血肉平原又添了一个我。
lines.en: The flesh plains gain another of me.
Wind leaks through the hole beneath bedrock.
The tide of rot pushes me ashore.

lines.zh: 我数着自己的骨头醒来。
lines.en: I wake counting my own bones.
Bone cage on fire, unbearable pain.
Bone cage shot, in excruciating pain.
Starve to death in the bone cage, uncompassionate.
Lightning strikes the bone cage, excruciating pain.
